result:
I fixed the new delete-description endpoint in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`. I did not run the tests or the app, as you asked.

- **Database access:** the route already went through `crud`, so nothing changed there. `crud.get_item` and `crud.clear_item_description` in `app/crud.py` do the session work.
- **Status codes:** the two integer literals (`404` and `403`) are now `status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND` and `status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN`. I added `status` to the existing `fastapi` import.

The existing routes in the same file still break both rules. `read_items`, `read_item`, `update_item` and `delete_item` call `session.exec`, `session.get`, `session.add`, `session.delete` or `session.commit` directly, and they use integer status codes. I left them alone because they predate this change and you asked only about the new code. Say if you want them brought in line too.
